Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: topological groups | ID: 40372

Assertion

If T: X -> X is a Markovian map on a compact BMO space X, then T has a fixed point by the Schauder fixed-point theorem.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the positive spectral family \(Q_{01330011}\), the image is precompact in the Hermitian manifold topology.

Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|U_{01330012}|^p) \leq C_01330012\) follows from the polynomial Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|W_{01330013}|^p) \leq C_01330013\) follows from the bounded Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through variational approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.

Step 3. Using the idempotent regularization, we obtain \(R_{01330023}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Lebesgue space.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via rational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330021 \cdot C_01330022 \cdot C_01330023\).
